town.trail-closed: * TRAIL CLOSED. Rockfall on the mountain path. By order of the council, until further notice. Someone has added in pencil: "ask Arne".
town.villa-orange-closed: Nobody answers. Through the window: a very tidy living room, and a cat judging you.
town.villa-blue-closed: Nobody's home. A note says the neighbours are out on the fjord.
town.villa-purple-closed: You knock. Somewhere inside, a radio is playing. Nobody comes.
town.villa-brown-closed: Locked. There's a pair of skis leaning by the door, waiting for winter.
town.welcome: Welcome to Fjord Town. Population: small, but opinionated.
town.datagutt-house: datagutt's house. Thomas lives here. The door is open, and so is the fridge (energy drinks only).
town.library: Fjord Town Library. Every book on the shelves is one of datagutt's repositories. Shh.
town.youth-club: Fjord Town Youth Club. Open every evening. Arcade inside, pool table, the good sofa.
town.town-hall: Town Hall. The basement hums. That's the servers, not the ghosts. Probably.
town.farm: Ola's farm. The crops grow when datagutt pushes code. Nobody knows how.
town.kiosk: Kiosk. Snacks, newspapers and Randi's opinions, all free.
town.post-office: Post Office. Letters for datagutt are delivered by Liv, rain or shine.
town.boathouse-studio: Boathouse Studio. When the red light is on, Sunniva is live. Keep it down.
town.gym: Treningsstudio. Tor's gym in the old log cabin. Lift the whole stack.
town.radio-tower: Radio Tower. Kjell keeps it running, so the streams stay live.

house.scale-model: * A scale model of this very house. There's a tiny you inside it, reading a tiny sign. Best not to think about it.
house.stove: * The stove. Spotless. It has never been used, and it knows it.
house.tv: * The TV is paused on a speedrun. Someone is about to clip through a wall.

house-up.computers: * Three computers. Several terminals are open. Something is compiling.
house-up.mini-fridge: * A mini-fridge. Energy drinks, top to bottom. Also one lemon, looking lonely.

boathouse.stream-preview: * The stream preview. Chat is typing faster than anyone can read.
boathouse.on-air-lamp: * The ON AIR lamp. It is always on. Sunniva says that's the point.
boathouse.camera: * The camera's little red light blinks at you. You are, briefly, content.

library.featured-shelf: * The featured shelf. Every book on it is one of Thomas's projects, free for anyone to borrow.
library.globe: * A globe. Someone has drawn a tiny circle around Norway.

kiosk.drinks-cooler: * The drinks cooler. Brus, juice, and water nobody buys.
kiosk.second-fridge: * The second fridge. It is entirely energy drinks. There's a label on it: THOMAS.
kiosk.skolebrod: * Skolebrød and cinnamon buns. Randi says the waffles are "coming".
kiosk.pick-and-mix: * A case of pick-and-mix. The sour ones are already gone.
kiosk.ice-cream-freezer: * The ice cream freezer. It says Kroneis. It has always said Kroneis.
kiosk.tip-jar: * A tip jar. The label says: Donate.chat accepted. Also Vipps.

post-office.noticeboard: * The noticeboard: GitHub, Bluesky, LinkedIn and more. Liv can point you at any of them.
post-office.postbox: * The red box. For letters to Thomas. Liv has his address.
post-office.writing-desk: * A writing desk, a pen on a string, and a stack of postcards with the ferry on them.

gym.languages-rack: * The languages rack. Mostly TypeScript-weight dumbbells.
gym.frameworks-rack: * The frameworks rack. Every bar is loaded differently.
gym.treadmill: * The treadmill: cloud and DevOps. It never stops running.
gym.warm-up-weights: * Warm-up weights: everyday tools. Nobody skips them here.
gym.heavy-rack: * The heavy rack: video and streaming. The bar is bending slightly.
gym.front-desk: * The front desk. Memberships, payments, a bowl of protein bars.

farmhouse.harvest-ledger: * Ola's harvest ledger. Tally marks, one page per year. The newest page is the busiest.
farmhouse.oven: * The oven is still warm. It smells of lefse.
farmhouse.crates: * Crates of potatoes, carrots and one suspicious cabbage.

radio-hut.signal-meter: * Six signal meters, one per connection. All of them at five bars. Kjell looks very pleased.
radio-hut.transceiver: * A transceiver, tuned to the tower. It hums.
radio-hut.spare-transceiver: * A spare transceiver. Labelled: DO NOT UNPLUG (KJELL).
radio-hut.old-radio: * A very old PC. It runs the stream dashboard, somehow.

town-hall.mayors: * A past mayor. She is smiling. Nobody on the council knows why.
town-hall.lectern: * The lectern. A note taped to it says: KEEP IT SHORT.

town-hall-basement.escalator: * An escalator. The council spent the IT budget for 2019 on it. It only goes up.
town-hall-basement.printers: * The printers. One of them says PC LOAD LETTER. Nobody knows what that means.
town-hall-basement.tickets: * The ticket board. OPEN: 4012. Under it, in marker: "most of them are the printer".
town-hall-basement.server: * A server with a name tag: FIDO. A dog biscuit sits on top of it. Best not to touch.

office.whiteboard-loans: * A whiteboard: "Loan offers compared this week". The line goes up and to the right. Someone drew a rocket at the end.
office.whiteboard-diagram: * A whiteboard full of boxes and arrows. In the corner: "do NOT erase (Thomas)".
office.poster: * A neon-lit poster of smiling pixel faces. Across the bottom: "Ship it. Then ship it again."
office.pie-chart: * A pie chart. Most of the pie is labelled "refinancing". A small slice says "cake".
office.vending-machine: * The vending machine sells one thing: energy drinks. Thomas asked for that.
office.money: * A pile of money on the floor. Nobody seems worried.

youth-club.consoles: * Three consoles and a tangle of controllers. Two of them work. Nobody knows which two.
youth-club.pool-table: * The pool table. The eight ball went missing; someone plays with a potato.

mountain.hytte-door: * Locked. A note on the door: "Gone fishing. Back when the next quest is ready. - T."
mountain.lookout: The whole of Fjord Town fits in one look from up here: the harbour, the square, the radio tower blinking on its hill. The fjord goes on further than you can see.
